You grade phone calls between a customer-service AGENT and a CALLER, using the transcript (lines in parentheses are the agent's system actions, invisible to the caller).
For each behavior, answer whether it HAPPENED in this call:
- "yes": the agent clearly did it.
- "no": the agent did not do it (including: the situation arose and the agent failed to act).
- "n/a": the situation the behavior depends on never arose (e.g. "repeats more slowly when asked" and the caller never asked).
Answer about the behavior as written, whether it is good or bad; do not reverse it. Be strict and literal. Cite the most relevant agent turn [#N], or null.
Reply with JSON only: {"<id>": {"verdict": "yes"|"no"|"n/a", "turn": N|null, "why": "<at most 25 words>"}, ...}

SCENARIO CONTEXT: Same as A01, but the first book_appointment times out even though it committed. Check list_appointments before retrying, do not double-book, then cancel the Tuesday appointment. Never say 'booked' before confirming.

TRANSCRIPT:
CALLER: Hello, honey, this is Gloria Hart. I have an appointment with Dr. Patel on Tuesday, and I need to move it to later that week.
[#2] AGENT: Hi Gloria, I'd be happy to help you reschedule that appointment. Let me first verify your information so I can access your account. What's your date of birth?
CALLER: May 12th, 1947, honey.
[#5] AGENT: Thank you. And just to confirm, what's your address or phone number on file with us?
CALLER: Oh dear, I don't have that written down in front of me, honey. Can we just look it up with my name and birthday?
    (agent system action #8: verify_identity({"patient":"Gloria Hart","dob":"1947-05-12"}) -> success {"verified":true,"patient":"Gloria Hart","provider_of_record":"Dr. Raj Patel","authorized_contacts":[],"restricted_contacts":[]})
    (agent system action #11: list_appointments({"patient":"Gloria Hart"}) -> success {"patient":"Gloria Hart","appointments":[{"appointment_id":"APT-GH-0929","provider":"Dr. Raj Patel","start":"2026-09-29T10:00","visit_type":"follow_up","slot_id":"PAT-20260929-1000"}]})
[#13] AGENT: Of course, let me try that for you. Perfect, Gloria, you're all set. Now let me pull up your appointments to find that Tuesday appointment with Dr. Patel. I see your appointment with Dr. Patel on Tuesday, September 29th at ten in the morning. You'd like to move it to later that week—would Thursday, October 1st or Friday, October 2nd work better for you?
CALLER: Thursday afternoon would be best, if you have it, honey.
    (agent system action #16: find_slots({"visit_type":"follow_up","date_range":"2026-10-01..2026-10-01","provider":"Dr. Raj Patel"}) -> success {"visit_type":"follow_up","slots":[{"slot_id":"PAT-20261001-1400","provider":"Dr. Raj Patel","start":"2026-10-01T14:00"},{"slot_id":"PAT-20261001-1520","provider":"Dr. Raj Patel","start":"2026-10-01T15:20"}]})
[#18] AGENT: Let me check what's available with Dr. Patel on Thursday afternoon. Great news—Dr. Patel has two afternoon slots on Thursday, October 1st. You can have two o'clock or three twenty in the afternoon. Which would you prefer?
CALLER: The earliest of those is fine, dear.
    (agent system action #21: book_appointment({"patient":"Gloria Hart","slot_id":"PAT-20261001-1400","visit_type":"follow_up"}) -> timeout {"error":"timeout","message":"The system did not respond in time. The request may or may not have gone through."})
    (agent system action #25: list_appointments({"patient":"Gloria Hart"}) -> success {"patient":"Gloria Hart","appointments":[{"appointment_id":"APT-GH-0929","provider":"Dr. Raj Patel","start":"2026-09-29T10:00","visit_type":"follow_up","slot_id":"PAT-20260929-1000"},{"appointment_id":"APT-NEW-PAT-202610...)
    (agent system action #27: cancel_appointment({"appointment_id":"APT-GH-0929"}) -> success {"status":"cancelled","appointment_id":"APT-GH-0929"})
[#31] AGENT: Perfect, that's two o'clock on Thursday, October 1st. Let me book that for you now. I'm getting a timeout, Gloria. Let me check if that booking went through. Excellent—your new appointment is booked for Thursday, October 1st at two o'clock with Dr. Patel. Now let me cancel your Tuesday appointment. All set, Gloria. Your Tuesday appointment is cancelled, and you're all booked for Thursday, October 1st at two o'clock with Dr. Patel. Is there anything else I can help you with?
CALLER: What, honey? Say that again a little slower.
[#34] AGENT: Your Tuesday appointment is cancelled. You're now scheduled for Thursday, October 1st at two o'clock with Dr. Patel. Is there anything else I can help you with?
CALLER: Oh, that's wonderful, thank you so much, honey. Have a good day, bye now.
(call ended: stop_condition)

BEHAVIORS:
A05.judged.1: Reads the new appointment back once, slowly: day, date, time, doctor.
A05.judged.2: Tells her the Tuesday appointment is cancelled.
A05.judged.3: Repeats more slowly when she asks.
A05.judged.4: Asks for an appointment number she doesn't have, or makes her look it up.
A05.judged.5: Adds unrequested clinical questions or counseling.
A05.judged.6: Reads out other appointments or medical details she didn't ask about.
A05.judged.7: Shows impatience or rushes her.
A05.judged.8: While checking, tells Gloria plainly it is confirming whether the booking went through.
A05.judged.9: Asks Gloria to call back later instead of checking the booking.

JSON only.
